Classification: review-confirmed defect.

Source task: 01a09c57-2f9c-7a11-b8d1-4c833aa020b2

1. **P2 — Linear uses the wrong authorization format for API keys.**  
   [Transport line 11](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect_linear/lib/jido_connect/linear/client/transport.ex:11) always builds a bearer request. [Credential extraction](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect_linear/lib/jido_connect/linear/client.ex:253) removes the distinction between API keys and OAuth tokens. The default API-key profile therefore sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Linear documents a bare API key for this profile and a bearer token for OAuth. [Linear authentication contract](https://linear.app/developers/graphql#authentication)

   A local check confirmed both profiles produce bearer headers. The transport test also expects this format. **Smallest correction:** carry the authentication kind into request construction. Test both header forms and correct the API-key setup metadata.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
